title: Legendary Jamaican Chicken Biryani
description: A buttery, cheese-pull Jamaican dish featuring biryani masala, perfect for a date night in. This nut-free-friendly recipe is a twist on traditional Caribbean cuisine.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes, then set aside.
In the same skillet, add the onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the biryani masala and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
